content.short: Huff is a low-level programming language for writing optimized EVM smart contracts.
content.description: Huff was created by the Aztec Protocol to support an on-chain Ethereum program that required highly optimized code. With Huff, developers can manipulate memory at the system level of the EVM, enabling fine-grained control over how data is stored and accessed. Learning Huff provides deeper insight into the inner workings of the EVM and how low-level instructions map to on-chain behavior. As a newer language, Huff is building a fast-growing community of practitioners.
